stakes.prenda: the loser takes off a piece of clothing.
stakes.desnuda: the winner takes a piece of clothing off the loser, however they like.
stakes.reto: the loser does a dare with the winner.
stakes.caricia: the loser gives the winner a caress.
stakes.servir: the winner chooses where: the loser receives a caress.
stakes.verdad: the loser answers a truth about the winner.

rules: How to play: take turns rolling a ten-sided die: {verdad}, {reto}, {caricia} (a random caress: what, where and for how many seconds), {desnuda} (you take a piece of clothing off your partner, your choice), {prenda} (you take off one of your own), {duelo} (a random challenge against your partner or whoever you pick; the loser pays the stake: a piece of clothing, a dare, a caress…), {mandas} (you pick someone and give them a truth or a dare), {comodin} (keep it to skip one card without drinking), {brindis} (everybody drinks) and {todos} (something everyone does at once with their partner, or with the person on their right in free-for-all). If you don't want to do a card, drink and pass the turn; if you don't fancy a card you can swap it once with «Another card». In Settings you can write your own cards. Timed cards come with a countdown: tap it to start. The die never lands on the same face twice in a row and only lands on faces that can be done: if you have no clothes left you won't get Strip, and if the person you would undress has none, you won't get Undress me. In couples mode, cards go to your partner, unless with several couples you choose crossed duels or everything crossed; in free-for-all, to someone at the table you might like, based on what each player said. Drink responsibly: you can also play without alcohol.

ui.foot: If someone doesn't feel like doing something, they say so and drink. What matters is that everyone has a good time.
ui.age_p: Dado Atrevido is a game for adults, with spicy questions and dares. Play only if everyone is over 18 and everyone wants to.
ui.cross_note_duelo: Duels are against someone from another couple; all other cards are with your partner.
ui.cross_note_todo: Duels and half of the dares, caresses, truths and Undress me cards go to someone from another couple.
